summary: A large, easy-to-read text field with an optional label, and a message below that shows an error or helper text.
purpose: Makes forms easier to read and fill in, especially for older users.
why: Header says high-legibility, elderly-friendly forms. The tall field and large text match that goal.
how: Shows an optional label above, then the input at a large height. The border turns red when there is an error. Below the field, it shows the error if there is one, otherwise the helper text.
inputs: Standard input props, plus label, error and helperText.
outputs: A form field. Typed values reach the parent through the normal input handling.
risks: The label is not tied to the input by an id here, so screen readers may not read it with the field unless the caller sets one. Only one message shows at a time, so a helper hint is hidden when an error appears.
debug: If an error does not show, check that the error prop is passed. If the label is not read aloud, check whether an id is linked to the input.
